title: Free-boundary disks in a superball
plain: In a round ball the only free-boundary minimal disks are flat. In the superball x⁴+y⁴+z⁴ ≤ 1, is there one that is not a flat slice?
math: Let $B=\{x^4+y^4+z^4\le1\}$. Decide whether there is an embedded minimal disk $\Sigma\subset B$ with $\partial\Sigma\subset\partial B$ meeting $\partial B$ orthogonally that is not contained in a plane.
